newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - DEC 31.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - DEC 31.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- It was not the Finance Ministry's wish to repurchase Polgari Bank from the private owner, the ministry only fulfilled its cotractual duty, said former Privatisation Minister Tamas Suchman.
- A company court official denied rumours that from January 1 it will be more expensive to set up limited companies.
- The police commisioner of Heves county has sacked the head and deputy head of Hatvan police.
- The record highs of the BUX index prove that foreign investors continue to trust the Hungarian economy.
